original_record.question: X 8 cm Z Y In the figure above, YXZ = 300, XYZ = 1050 and XY = 8cm. Calculate YZ.
original_record.ai_explanation: In triangle XYZ, angle Z = 180° - 30° - 105° = 45°; using sine rule: YZ/sin(30°) = XY/sin(45°) gives YZ = 8 × sin(30°)/sin(45°) = 8 × (1/2)/(√2/2) = 8/√2 = 4√2... rechecking yields 8√2 cm.

candidate.question: In triangle XYZ shown, angle YXZ = 30°, angle XYZ = 105° and XY = 8 cm. Calculate YZ.
candidate.ai_explanation: The angles in a triangle sum to 180°, so angle XZY = 180° − 30° − 105° = 45°. By the sine rule, YZ/sin 30° = 8/sin 45°. Therefore YZ = 8 × (1/2)/(√2/2) = 4√2 cm.
